{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is the sentinel value (-999.0)
# as it likely indicates missing or invalid data
filtered_df = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value across all patients (excluding sentinel values)
mean_baseline = filtered_df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Return the result
mean_baseline"}
